note: Canonical customization patterns. Reviewers reuse these ids; aliases map names used in earlier reviews. Edit to merge or split patterns (see SKILL.md).

patterns.name: Configurable auth audience / scope
patterns.description: Client option or constructor argument that sets the token audience or scopes for bearer-token auth.

patterns.name: Challenge-based auth policy
patterns.description: Handwritten auth policy that handles WWW-Authenticate challenges (Key Vault, Container Registry style).

patterns.name: Service-specific auth headers
patterns.description: Policies that set subscription keys, regions or other auth headers per credential type.

patterns.name: Gzip request bodies
patterns.description: Compresses request payloads before sending.

patterns.name: Client-side batching of uploads
patterns.description: Splits large uploads into size-bounded batches and sends them (often concurrently).

patterns.name: Partial-failure reporting for batches
patterns.description: Aggregates per-batch failures into an exception, callback or event instead of failing the whole call.

patterns.name: Convenience overload that unpacks an options model
patterns.description: Public method takes an options object or flattened parameters and calls the generated operation.

patterns.name: Typed convenience method over a protocol method
patterns.description: Handwritten typed method that wraps a generated protocol/raw method or private operation.

patterns.name: Hide or remove generated API surface
patterns.description: Makes generated methods, types, constructors or setters internal, or removes them.

patterns.name: Alternative model constructors
patterns.description: Handwritten constructors for models, often one per variant of a one-of input (URL vs bytes).

patterns.name: BinaryData / bytes accessor
patterns.description: Accessor converting between the wire type and a richer binary type.

patterns.name: Model toString / display
patterns.description: Handwritten string representation of a model.

patterns.name: Replace a generated type with another
patterns.description: Swaps a generated model for a shared or handwritten type (CloudEvent, wrapper dictionaries).

patterns.name: Model property alias or addition
patterns.description: Adds or renames model properties (backward-compatible aliases, computed properties).

patterns.name: LRO operation ID exposure
patterns.description: Extracts the operation ID (often from the Operation-Location header) and exposes it on the poller or result.

patterns.name: Custom LRO poller or result shaping
patterns.description: Overrides begin/poll methods, poller return types, default polling intervals or final-result unwrapping.

patterns.name: Custom paging / next-link handling
patterns.description: Handwritten pagers: next links from headers, continuation tokens, termination rules, page metadata.

patterns.name: API version handling
patterns.description: Validates, curates or enumerates supported service versions in handwritten code.

patterns.name: Hand-written client layered over generated code
patterns.description: The public client is largely handwritten and delegates to an internal generated client.

patterns.name: Custom error types
patterns.description: Handwritten error/exception types or error parsing.

patterns.name: Cloud-aware client configuration
patterns.description: Client constructors or options that select endpoints/audiences per Azure cloud.

patterns.name: Tracing around handwritten methods
patterns.description: Adds tracing spans or telemetry to handwritten convenience methods.

patterns.name: Typed streaming / SSE events
patterns.description: Turns a streamed response into typed events.

patterns.name: Ranged / chunked downloads
patterns.description: Downloads content in ranges or chunks, with validation.

patterns.name: Custom retry behavior
patterns.description: Changes which status codes or conditions are retried.

patterns.name: Options mapped to request headers
patterns.description: Typed options that are serialized into headers such as Prefer.
